verdict.rationale: Snowflake provides multiple governed, non-dashboard paths for an agent to run SQL end-to-end: the SQL API (REST) for authenticating and executing queries/managing objects, the Snowflake CLI for programmatic access, RBAC/access history for governance, and a Snowflake-managed MCP server that lets agents securely retrieve data and execute SQL as tools without deploying infrastructure. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of the full agent workflow (auth→discover→query→read-results) via CLI/API/MCP, and explicit documentation of schema-discovery APIs (e.g., information_schema access) tied directly to the MCP/SQL API flow.
